title: Danang Seafood Market Tasting Tour
description: Dive into the frantic energy of Danang's coastal fish markets, tasting massive tiger prawns, squid, and scallops grilled to order right on the sand.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   This 3-hour evening "Danang Seafood Market Tasting Tour" offers a low-physical-demand, authentic coastal experience on the Son Tra Peninsula, featuring hand-picked live seafood grilled to order. It is specifically recommended as an evening activity following a round of golf at BRG Danang.
> *   Guests select seafood like tiger prawns, squid, scallops, mantis shrimp, and lobsters directly from tanks, which are then grilled over open coals with scallion oil and crushed peanuts. The experience includes luxury SUV transfers and is available year-round, requiring advance booking.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Dive into the frantic energy of Danang's coastal fish markets, tasting massive tiger prawns, squid, and scallops grilled to order right on the sand.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Danang has historically been a major fishing port. While luxury resorts have taken over the beaches, the authentic seafood culture thrives at local coastal markets where the catch is brought in fresh daily and cooked utilizing incredibly simple, spicy marinades.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Your private guide navigates you to a bustling, local-only seafood strip along the Son Tra Peninsula. You handpick live seafood—from mantis shrimp to massive lobsters—directly from the tanks. 

The vendors grill your selection over open coals, dressing them in scallion oil and crushed peanuts. You feast at a plastic table practically touching the ocean, pairing the intense garlic and chili flavors with ice-cold local beer.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Bustling, Authentic, Coastal |
| **Duration** | 3 Hours (Evening) |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | An evening following a round of golf at BRG Danang. |

## Sequencing a Son Tra Coastal Seafood Feast After BRG Da Nang or Montgomerie Links
Because Da Nang’s daily fishing fleet unloads its prime catch along the Son Tra Peninsula and Vo Nguyen Giap coastal boulevard between 4:00 PM and 5:30 PM, the **Danang Seafood Market Tasting Tour** is engineered as a relaxed 6:00 PM post-round evening feast. Groups teeing off at 07:30 or 08:00 at [BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (Norman Course)](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/), [BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-nicklaus/), or [Montgomerie Links](/courses/vietnam/montgomerie-links/) finish 18 holes by 12:30 PM, leaving four hours to swim and unwind at [InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/intercontinental-danang/), [Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang](/accommodations/vietnam/fusion-resort-villa-da-nang/), or our private [An Bang Beachfront Villas](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/) before heading to the live tanks.

Unlike hotel buffets that pre-cook reef fish hours ahead, Son Tra’s open-air seafood institutions price catches by live weight straight from aerated seawater tanks—allowing your culinary host to inspect lively mantis shrimp (*tôm tích*), spotted babylon snails (*ốc hương*), blue swimmer crabs, and East Sea rock lobster minutes before they hit the charcoal grill.

## Tank-to-Table Selection & Concierge Hygiene Standards
* **Vetted Seawater Tank Establishments:** Asia Golf Specialists partners exclusively with top-tier Son Tra seafood houses (such as *Bé Mặn*, *Năm Đảnh*, and private VIP coastal pavilions) where tank filtration, transparent per-kilogram pricing, and high-heat wok sanitation are verified daily.
* **Signature Central Coast Preparations:** Your guide sequences four distinct flavor profiles across the meal: mantis shrimp flash-fried with crispy garlic, *ốc hương* sautéed in salted duck egg yolk, wild groupers steamed with soy, ginger, and scallions, and charcoal-grilled scallops topped with scallion oil and crushed Quang Nam peanuts—paired with ice-cold Larue or Huda draft beer and chilled New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc.
* **Seamless Nightcap Transitions:** Wrapping up around 8:30 PM positions your group 10 minutes from the Han River bridges, where your standby luxury MPV can drop you at [Sky36 Danang](/destinations/vietnam/vietnam-nightlife-sky36-danang/) or the hidden speakeasies of An Thuong during your [Vietnam Central Coast](/tours/vietnam-central-coast/) or [The Coastal Sprint](/tours/the-coastal-sprint/) itinerary.

faqs.q: Which Da Nang golf courses pair best with an evening Son Tra Seafood Market tour?
faqs.a: Morning rounds at BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (Norman or Nicklaus Courses) and Montgomerie Links sit just 20 to 25 minutes south of Son Tra Peninsula, letting your group refresh at your resort before a 6:00 PM live-tank seafood feast.

faqs.q: How does Asia Golf Specialists ensure food safety and fair pricing at Da Nang's live seafood markets?
faqs.a: Your bilingual culinary guide selects only active, live shellfish and reef fish from vetted high-turnover seawater tanks with transparent digital scale pricing, cooked immediately over high-heat charcoal grills and woks.

faqs.q: What local Central Vietnamese seafood dishes should golfers try on the Da Nang tasting tour?
faqs.a: Don't miss garlic-fried mantis shrimp (tôm tích), scallops grilled on the half-shell with scallion oil and crushed peanuts, tamarind-glazed blue crab, and steamed East Sea grouper wrapped in rice paper with fresh herbs.
